Best Bets • 10-02-26
North Texas Pride’s “Come As You Are” Pride festival is set for Saturday, Oct. 10, at the Art Centre of Plano. See listings for details.
………………..
October
Oct. 3: Avant Chamber Ballet presents ‘Together We Dance’
Avant Chamber Ballet and five fellow dance companies — Ballet Frontier, Bombshell Dance Project, DBDT: Encore!, Grackle Dance Collective and Pegasus Contemporary Ballet — present the free performance Together We Dance from 3-4:30 p.m. at Klyde Warren Park, 2012 Woodall Rogers Freeway
Oct. 3: Scarborough’s Hollow Fall Fantasy Fest
Scarborough’s Hollow Fall Fantasy Fest continues each Saturday through Oct. 31 and on Sunday, Nov. 1, from 1-9 p.m. at Scarborough Village, 2511 FM 66 in Waxahachie. Tickets start at $29.70 for adults and $16.50 for children ages 5-12. Children under 5
are admitted free. Tickets are available only at SRFestival.com.
Oct. 4: The Miss LifeWalk Pageant
Prism Health North Texas presents the annual Miss LifeWalk fundraising pageant from 4-6 p.m. in The Rose Room inside S4, 3911 Cedar Springs Road. The pageant, hosted by Marsha Dimes, features local drag performers competing for the title of Miss LifeWalk 2026, with cash prizes and a year-long role as an ambassador for PHNTX. Tickets start at $10 for standing room general admission, increasing to $45 for seated general admission and $75 for VIP seating, and are available online at LifeWalk.org.
Oct. 4: TAG+ Roll With Pride
Tyler Area Gays+ host “Roll with Pride,” an afternoon of D&D and tabletop games, from 1-5 p.m. at Geek World Games, 1859 Troup Highway. Visit the TAG+ Facebook page for more informataion.
Oct. 4: DHHRM Docent-Led Tour
The Dallas Holocaust and Human Rights Museum, 300 N. Houston St., offers a tour of the museum’s permanent exhibition led by one of the museum’s docent educators starting at 1:30 p.m. Tickets are $12-$19, available at DHHRM.org.
